title: QUALCOMM, Inc. (NASDAQ:QCOM) Upcoming Earnings will Unfolds its Future
text:
January 30, 2018 QUALCOMM, Inc. (NASDAQ:QCOM) Upcoming Earnings will Unfolds its Future 
Investors are keenly waiting for QUALCOMM, Inc. (NASDAQ:QCOM) earnings, as it will give direction, to serve as a gauge for investors, to decide whether the chip maker will remain an independent company, as it heads into its annual shareholder meeting in March or will not? 
Most of this quarter the chip-maker is dominated by the impact of hostile takeover attempt of Broadcom Limited (NASDAQ:AVGO) 
The company has done many things, among which it recently announces a $1 billion cost-reduction program, and for fiscal 2019, it is predicting an adjusted earnings of $6.75 to $7.50 a share. 
For shareholders, in start of January, Qualcomm Inc also sent a letter to reject a takeover bid by Broadcom (AVGO). In a move to replace the Qualcomm’s board, Broadcom Limited (NASDAQ:AVGO) also nominated a slate of directors in December. 
This in not the end, but Qualcomm Inc is also involved in one litigation issue with Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) in which it get a fine by European Union of $1.23 billion. QCOM was sued by Apple a year ago. 
The company also needs to still sort through litigation with Apple Inc. AAPL, -2.07% . Last week, the European Union fined Qualcomm $1.23 billion, or €997 million, for illegal payments made to Apple to use its chips exclusively in smartphones. Apple sued Qualcomm a year ago, claiming that it was using patents to extract unreasonable royalties, and it has been a constant focus in earnings calls ever since. 
Qualcomm Inc is set to announce fiscal first-quarter earnings after the bell on Wednesday. 
QUALCOMM, Inc. (NASDAQ:QCOM)’s stock on Monday traded at beginning with a price of $68.16 and when day-trade ended the stock finally plunged -1.77% to reach at $67.32. Analyst’s mean target price for QCOM is $67.89 while analysts mean recommendation is 2.50. Stock value has moved between $48.78 – 69.4 in last one year. 
Analyst’s ratings play a very important role in outlining a stock’s performance. Let us check out how analysts have ranked QCOM based on current scenarios. Stock has got OUTPERFORM rating from 7 analyst(s) whereas last month 6 analyst(s) have given outperform rating. SELL rating has been given by 0 analyst(s) and 3 analyst(s) given BUY rating to the stock. Company fiscal year is ending in September and analysts’ consensus recommendation is Outperform for QCOM and estimated EPS for next quarter is 1.00. 
QUALCOMM, Inc. (NASDAQ:QCOM) yearly performance is 24.12% and net profit margin is 11.10%. Annual EPS Growth of past 5 years is -11.60%. The current share price indicates that stock is -2.83% away from its one year high and is moving 37.61% ahead of its 52-week low.

AVGO’s distance from 20 day simple moving average is -6.89% and distance from 50-Day simple moving average is -7.66%. Analysts expect Broadcom Limited (NASDAQ:AVGO) to report 4.95 EPS and has got OUTPERFORM rating from 15 of Thomson Reuters analysts and 0 analyst(s) given UNDERPERFORM rating.
